items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Sonny was in Tiny’s band before I was.

ctx.x: Thought that that was the secret.

Yeah. And I used to try to copy him a little bit, as a matter of fact I didn’t know anything about Charlie Parker until Sonny Stitt alerted me to him. Sonny was in Tiny’s band before I was. He asked me, he used to come to Cincinnati a lot. He asked me if I heard this cat named Charlie Parker. I’d never heard of him before. And then I heard him later. I tried to play like him but that wasn’t my thing. No. I went back to my old original stuff.
